title: ServerManifest
description: The manifest shape the Elysium client parses. Mirrors the Rust struct `ServerManifest` in elysium: source/src-tauri/src/updater.rs. serde uses rename_all = camelCase and does NOT deny unknown fields, so extra keys are allowed (additionalProperties: true) and the server stays free to add keys without breaking installed clients. Keep this schema in sync with that struct.

additionalProperties.description: PlatformEntry. Rust declares only `url: Option<String>`; other keys (sha256, size, filename, note) are tolerated (not deny_unknown_fields).

url.description: Optional. Rust: `url: Option<String>`. When present it MUST resolve to HTTP 200 (enforced by CI). When absent, download_url deserializes to an empty string and no installer is offered.
